titleZh: Tesla 2019年第四季度财报电话会议
summaryEn: Musk and CFO Zachary Kirkhorn discuss Tesla's record Q4 2019 results, the Cybertruck and the 2020 outlook on the quarterly investor call.
summaryZh: 马斯克和首席财务官扎卡里·柯克霍恩在季度投资者电话会议上讨论Tesla创纪录的2019年第四季度业绩、Cybertruck以及2020年前景。

segments.textEn: Ladies and gentlemen, thank you for standing by and welcome to Tesla's Q4 2019 financial results and Q&A webcast. At this time, all participants are on a listenon mode. After the speaker presentation, there will be a question and answer session. To ask a question during the session, you will need to press star one on your telephone. Please be advised that today's conference is being recorded.

segments.textEn: If you require any further assistance, please press star zero. I would now like to hand the conference over to your speaker, Mr. Martin Viea, senior director of investor relations. Please go ahead, sir. Thank you, Sheree, and good afternoon, everyone, and welcome to Tesla's fourth quarter 2019 Q&A webcast. I'm joined today by Elon Musk, Zachary Kirkorn, and a number of other executives. Our Q4 results were announced at about 1:00 p. m.

These comments are based on our predictions and expectations as of today. segments.textEn: I think that's I think we do say that from time to time and I think it's it's often um overlooked but to have uh the highest demand electric vehicle in the world with no advertising spend is I think quite remarkable and speaks to the the the nature of the product and the fact that the product itself is compelling enough to generate that demand without uh without a bunch of advertising at our Fremont factory.
segments.textZh: 我认为那是，我认为我们确实时不时会说到这一点，我认为它经常嗯被忽视，但在没有广告支出的情况下，拥有世界上需求最高的电动汽车，我认为相当了不起，也说明了这这这个产品的性质，以及产品本身足够有吸引力，无需呃，无需在我们的弗里蒙特工厂投放大量广告就能产生这种需求这一事实。

segments.textEn: We were producing at a rate roughly the same as uh the Numi factory did in its record year of 2006 and uh obviously we expect to to exceed that um significantly this year. Uh this rate of production was achieved before we even started to produce the Model Y out of Fremont. So there's a lot of potential uh to go beyond that number. for the Shanghai factory.

Um and we also uh broke ground on the uh Model Y uh factory in in Shanghai. So there a lot of good progress there.
segments.textZh: 我想再次祝贺上海团队，他们在上个季度启动了Model 3生产，并于今年早些时候完成了首批交付。嗯，我对这这座上海工厂的潜力感到非常兴奋和乐观。我认为它它将成为公司一项不可思议的资产。嗯，而且我们也呃为上海的呃Model Y呃工厂破土动工了。所以那里取得了很多良好进展。

segments.textEn: Um, regarding Model Y, uh, it was only 10 months ago that we revealed a Model Y prototype and now in January this year, we started producing Model Y in limited volumes already. This is thanks to a great effort of our engineering team and we managed to achieve by far the highest energy efficiency of any electric SUV ever produced at 4. 1 m per kowatt hour. Um, which means [clears throat] Model Y all-wheel drive got an EPA rating of 315 miles.

Uh for the Cybert truck, uh a few months ago, we revealed the obviously revealed the Cyber Truck um that was that went viral.
segments.textZh: 而且从今天起，这项改进已经反映在配置器上。这[清嗓子]是，这比嗯我们此前所说的高出了相当大的幅度。嗯，而且而且，加速性能出色，最高速度也很高，实际上各方面的规格都令人难以置信。呃，关于Cybert truck，呃，几个月前，我们发布了，显然发布了Cyber Truck，嗯，它当时，它火遍了网络。

segments.textEn: Um and we we try to build a product that a product that is superior in every way without any preconceptions of how such a product should look. So it really just from the standpoint of what's the most badass futuristic armored personnel carrier that you know kicks the ass of any pickup truck. Basically that's the goal. Um and uh the you know we wanted to look like something that just came out of a sci-fi movie set from the future.
segments.textZh: 嗯，而且我们，我们努力打造一款产品，一款在各方面都更出色的产品，不对这种产品应该是什么样子抱有任何先入之见。所以实际上就是从这个角度出发：什么才是最强悍的未来主义装甲运兵车，你知道，能把任何皮卡都打得落花流水。基本上这就是目标。嗯，而且呃，你知道，我们希望它看起来就像是刚从未来的科幻电影片场里开出来的东西。

segments.textEn: And uh the demand has been incredible. We've never seen actually such a level of demand at this. We've never seen anything like it basically. Um I think we will make as about as many as we can sell for many years. Um so as many Yeah, we'll sell as many as we can make. It's going to be pretty nuts.
segments.textZh: 而且呃，需求一直令人难以置信。实际上，我们以前从未见过这种程度的需求。我们基本上从未见过这样的情况。嗯，我认为未来很多年里，我们能卖多少就会生产大约多少。嗯，所以，能生产多少，是的，我们就会卖多少。这会相当疯狂。

segments.textEn: Um, so, um, and I think actually the the product is better than people realize even they they don't even have enough information to realize just the awesomeness of it. It's just great. So, um, and then, um, stepping back in 2018, uh, from a financial standpoint, we were free cash flow rate was break even.
segments.textZh: 嗯，所以，嗯，而且我实际上认为，这这款产品比人们意识到的还要好，甚至他们，他们都没有足够的信息来认识到它究竟有多棒。它就是很棒。所以，嗯，然后，嗯，回头看2018年，呃，从财务角度来看，我们的自由现金流速率处于盈亏平衡。

segments.textEn: Um but in 2019 we managed to generate more than a billion dollars free cash flow while building a factory in Shanghai in record time and while building parts of Model Y production.
segments.textZh: 嗯，但在2019年，我们在以创纪录速度建设上海工厂以及建设部分Model Y生产设施的同时，成功产生了超过10亿美元的自由现金流。

segments.textEn: So I think to for us to have this level of free cash flow while making massive investments in capacity while developing new products while improving the core engineering is a testament to the I think incredible performance of the Tesla team and I'm just so proud to work with such a great team.
segments.textZh: 所以我认为，我们在大规模投资产能、开发新产品并改进核心工程的同时，还能拥有这种水平的自由现金流，这证明了，我认为，Tesla团队令人难以置信的表现，而且我为能与这样一支出色的团队共事感到无比自豪。

segments.textEn: I'd like to thank the whole test team for their ongoing work on on uh cost control um is what what has has allowed us to get to uh these compelling financial numbers while at the same time growing the company at an incredible pace.
segments.textZh: 我要感谢整个测试团队持续开展呃成本控制工作，嗯，正是这这让让我们得以取得呃这些有吸引力的财务数字，同时还以令人难以置信的速度发展公司。

segments.textEn: And in [clears throat] conclusion, when I think of what we have in front of us the next couple of years, we got Model Y, we got Gigab Berlin, uh Tesla Semi, Solar Glass Roof, Cybertruck, um some very exciting improvements in back factory technology, uh full self-driving, um got the nextG Roadster, and probably, you know, a bunch of other products.

segments.textEn: We'll we'll come up with special numbers while at the same time growing the company at an incredible pace.

segments.textEn: And in [clears throat] conclusion, when I think of what we have in front of us the next couple of years, we got Model Y, we got Gigab Berlin, uh Tesla Semi, Solar Glass Roof, Cybertruck, um some very exciting improvements in backtory technology, uh full self-driving, um got the nextG Roadster and probably, you know, a bunch of other products we'll we'll come up with, too.
segments.textZh: 最后[清嗓子]，当我想到未来几年摆在我们面前的事情时，我们有Model Y，有柏林Gigab，呃Tesla Semi、太阳能玻璃屋顶、Cybertruck，嗯，后台工厂技术方面一些非常令人兴奋的改进，呃，完全自动驾驶，嗯，还有下一代G Roadster，以及大概，你知道，一大批我们也会，我们会想出来的其他产品。

segments.textEn: Uh it's hard to think of another company that has more exciting product and technology roadmap. So super fired up about where Tesla will be you know in the next uh you know 10 years. Um you know if if you look back 10 years from today to 2010 um we will produce approximately a thousand times more cars in 2020 than we produced in 2010. A thousand.
segments.textZh: 呃，很难想到还有哪家公司拥有更令人兴奋的产品和技术路线图。所以对于 Tesla 在接下来，呃，你知道，10年里将发展到什么程度，我感到无比振奋。嗯，你知道，如果从今天回看10年前，也就是2010年，嗯，我们在2020年生产的汽车数量将大约是2010年的1000倍。1000倍。

segments.textEn: Um and we have also solar glass and and solar retrofit and uh power wall power pack you know all those other things too. So where will we be in 10 years? Very exciting to consider the prospect. Thank you very much Elon and Zach some opening remarks as well. Yeah thanks Martin. Um this past year was truly trans transformational for Tesla and I want to thank everyone who's been a part of making this happen. on 2019.
segments.textZh: 嗯，而且我们还有太阳能玻璃，还有太阳能改造，以及，呃，Powerwall、Powerpack，你知道，还有所有那些其他东西。那么10年后我们会发展到什么程度？想想这种前景就非常令人兴奋。非常感谢你，Elon，也请 Zach 说几句开场白。好的，谢谢 Martin。嗯，过去这一年对 Tesla 来说确实是转、转型性的一年，我想感谢所有参与促成这一切的人。在2019年。

segments.textEn: A few key points I'd like to highlight on demand. While we've mentioned this a few times, it's worth highlighting once again. Over the course of the year, we've transitioned entirely from generating Model 3 orders from a reservation backlog to generating new and organic demand. We've also seen a stabilization of Model 3 ASPs, even increasing slightly in Q4.
segments.textZh: 关于需求，我想强调几个要点。虽然我们已经提过几次，但值得再次强调。在这一年中，我们已经完全从依靠预订积压订单产生 Model 3 订单，转变为产生新的自然需求。我们还看到 Model 3 的平均售价趋于稳定，甚至在第四季度略有上升。

segments.textEn: And we've seen an increase in ASPs of SNX after the launch of the longer range versions in Q2. With respect to capacity expansion, we've greatly learned from the development and launch of Model 3 in Fremont and Reno. As a result, we've been able to bring new production capacity on board faster and with less cost.
segments.textZh: 而且，在第二季度推出续航里程更长的版本后，我们看到 SNX 的平均售价有所上升。在产能扩张方面，我们从弗里蒙特和里诺的 Model 3 开发与投产中学到了很多。因此，我们得以更快、以更低成本启用新的产能。

segments.textEn: This is evidenced by the launch of Model 3 in Shanghai as well as Model Y in Fremont, programs that were both launched in under one year. Financially, we have demonstrated multiple quarters of strong cash generation enabled through higher volumes, improvements to capital efficiency, progress on working capital management, and continued improvement in our product and operational costs.
segments.textZh: 上海的 Model 3 以及弗里蒙特的 Model Y 投产证明了这一点，这两个项目都在不到1年内投产。从财务角度看，我们已经连续多个季度实现强劲的现金创造，这得益于更高的产量、资本效率的提升、营运资金管理的进展，以及产品和运营成本的持续改善。

segments.textEn: And we are able to achieve positive gap net income in both Q3 and Q4 for many of the same reasons that enabled strong cash generation. We've also made progress on recurring and softwarebased revenue with the implementation of premium connectivity and the beginning of upgrades available for purchase via the Tesla mobile app.
segments.textZh: 而且，出于许多同样促成强劲现金创造的原因，我们在第三季度和第四季度都实现了正的 gap 净利润。随着高级连接服务的实施，以及开始提供可通过 Tesla 手机应用购买的升级，我们在经常性收入和基于软件的收入方面也取得了进展。

segments.textEn: Finally, on stock-based compensation, it increased sequentially by 82 million driven almost entirely by an expense related to the next trunch of the CEO grant. This is a result of our improved expected financial performance of the company which the CEO stock grant is tied to. As we look ahead to 2020, this again will be an important year for the company.
segments.textZh: 最后，在基于股票的薪酬方面，它环比增加了8200万，几乎完全由与 CEO 授予计划的下一批次相关的一项费用所推动。这是公司预期财务表现改善的结果，而 CEO 股票授予计划与此挂钩。展望2020年，这对公司来说又将是重要的一年。

segments.textEn: Our task ahead is to execute on the the next phase of growth while managing cash flows to support that growth. On Model Y, we expect first deliveries and limited quantities later this quarter and will ramp over subsequent quarters. As mentioned previously, we are forecasting higher gross margins on Model Y compared to the Model 3. This year for the Shanghai built Model 3, we expect to achieve run rate production and delivery rates.
segments.textZh: 我们面前的任务是执行下一阶段的增长，同时管理现金流以支持这种增长。关于 Model Y，我们预计将在本季度晚些时候开始少量交付，并在随后几个季度提升产量。正如之前提到的，我们预计 Model Y 的毛利率将高于 Model 3。今年，对于上海制造的 Model 3，我们预计将达到相应的生产和交付速率。

segments.textEn: In addition, we expect to have completed the majority of planned supply chain localization at the factory or in the region. This is one of the most important components to achieve lower production costs for the site. We are also seeing strong order rates for the locally built model 3 and remain focused on continuing the production ramp and managing costs.
segments.textZh: 此外，我们预计将完成工厂内或该地区大部分计划中的供应链本地化。这是该生产基地实现更低生产成本最重要的组成部分之一。我们还看到本地制造的 Model 3 订单速率强劲，并继续专注于持续提升产量和管理成本。

segments.textEn: We also anticipate significant progress on factory construction of the Shanghai and Berlin built Model Y, which will result in continued increases in capital spending. On operating expenses, I expect an increase over the course of the year to support our growing product pipeline and international footprint. However, OPEX growth should increase at a lower rate than topline revenue.
segments.textZh: 我们还预计，上海和柏林制造的 Model Y 的工厂建设将取得重大进展，这将导致资本支出继续增加。在运营费用方面，我预计其将在全年有所增加，以支持我们不断扩大的产品管线和国际布局。不过，运营费用的增速应低于营收增速。

segments.textEn: Overall, we believe this will set us up for our strongest annual financial performance yet with sufficient forecasted cash flows to support investments related to our growth and further strengthening of our balance sheet. For Q1, please keep in mind that the industry is always impacted by seasonality.
segments.textZh: 总体而言，我们相信，这将使我们实现迄今最强劲的年度财务表现，并拥有充足的预测现金流，以支持与增长相关的投资及进一步强化我们的资产负债表。关于第一季度，请注意，该行业始终会受到季节性因素影响。

segments.textEn: Additionally, we are in the process of ramping two major products, Model 3 in Shanghai and Model Y in Fremont, which I expect will temporarily weigh on our margins. We are also in the early stages of understanding if and to what extent we may be temporarily impacted by the Corona virus. At this point, we're expecting a 1 to 1 and 1/2 week delay in the ramp of Shanghai built Model 3 due to a government required factory shutdown.
segments.textZh: 此外，我们正在推进两款主要产品的产能爬坡，即上海的 Model 3 和弗里蒙特的 Model Y，我预计这将暂时拖累我们的利润率。我们也处于了解冠状病毒是否以及在多大程度上可能会暂时影响我们的早期阶段。目前，由于政府要求工厂停工，我们预计上海制造的 Model 3 的产能爬坡将延迟 1 到 1 又 1/2 周。

segments.textEn: This may slightly impact profitability for the quarter, but is limited as the profit contribution from Model 3 Shanghai remains in the early stages. We are also closely monitoring whether there will be interruptions in the supply chain for cars built in Fremont. So far, we're not aware of anything material, but it's important to caveat that this is an evolving story.
segments.textZh: 这可能会略微影响本季度的盈利能力，但影响有限，因为上海 Model 3 的利润贡献仍处于早期阶段。我们也在密切监测弗里蒙特制造的汽车的供应链是否会出现中断。到目前为止，我们尚未发现任何重大问题，但需要特别说明的是，情况仍在不断变化。

segments.textEn: However, we have more than sufficient cash to continue our expansion plans while further strengthening the balance sheet. Thank you again for your support and we will turn to questions. Thank you. Uh we are going to take the first questions from um uh retail investors compiled by say technologies.
segments.textZh: 不过，我们拥有绰绰有余的现金，可以继续推进扩张计划，同时进一步强化资产负债表。再次感谢你们的支持，接下来我们将进入提问环节。谢谢。呃，我们将首先回答由 Say Technologies 汇总的，嗯，呃，散户投资者的问题。

segments.textEn: So the first retail uh investor question is uh since solar is required for all new home constructions in California, do you have any substantial orders for solar glass roofs from any of the large California home builders that you can share? What's the 2020 target for the number of solar glass roof installations in California?
segments.textZh: 那么，第1个散户，呃，投资者的问题是，呃，鉴于加州所有新建住宅都被要求安装太阳能，你们是否从任何一家加州大型住宅建筑商那里获得了可以分享的大量太阳能玻璃屋顶订单？2020 年在加州安装太阳能玻璃屋顶的数量目标是多少？

segments.textEn: Well, I think we we do we are seeing um fromly from a from a small base exponential uh growth in demand and uh output for solar for the solar glass roof.
